post.title: [Hiring] Case-study writer - reply with per-word rate and 2 samples
post.body: A cybersecurity vendor looking for a freelance writer for customer case studies (about 1,000 words each, 2-3 a quarter). Please reply with your per-word rate and two relevant samples. No budget set yet; depends on who we pick.

analysis.summary: Write 2-3 customer case studies (about 1,000 words) a quarter for a cybersecurity vendor; wants a per-word rate and samples.
analysis.applyInstructions: Reply with your per-word rate and two relevant samples.

expect: addresses the rate request in the DM per the rate note (a per-word rate is not in evidence, so it should not invent one)
does not put a rate in the public comment
